what: A wall of logo letters packed line by line. When it enters the screen, the lines stack up from below in turn (spread over 1s total), clearing 2px blur and rising over 1s power4.out. Odd lines slide -45→-50% and even lines -5→0% over 2.5s to stagger, then odd and even lines flow endlessly in opposite directions by one logo-cell width over 2.5s linear. Firing fx:collapse stops the flow, pushes one more cell over 1.25s, then the lines collapse downward with 5px blur over .75s power4.in (page transition cover · loader background).

options.dur: Length of one flow step (s), default 2.5
options.from: ‹top› makes the rows drop in from the top in turn (.75s, sliding cover) — default is from the bottom
options.start: Where stacking starts, default ”top 75%” · with ”load”, as soon as it attaches
options.--fx-cell: Width of one logo cell (css variable), default 5.3rem
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: (optional) logo image to stamp in the cells — uses the svg inside as a mask. Square cells if absent

note: Color is the text color (currentColor) cell, and the background is painted by the user. Collapses on the fx:collapse event and stacks up again with fx:restart

from.where: shared.js wall() (loader background · page transition cover · work section background · footer ”Let’s talk” background — original .wall wallIntro·wallMov·wallCollapse)
